title: Multimedia Designer
description:
Company Description

Numana SEO is a results-driven digital marketing company specializing in crafting effective and data-driven strategies to enhance online presence. They offer a wide range of services, including Web Design, Search Engine Optimization, Pay Per Click Advertising, Social Media Management, Brand Development, and Content Creation. Numana SEO is dedicated to helping businesses grow through innovative and tailored marketing solutions. By combining creativity and data analytics, the team ensures maximum impact for their clients.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Multimedia Designer. The Multimedia Designer will be responsible for creating visually engaging content that aligns with the company's marketing initiatives. Daily tasks may include designing graphics, developing multimedia content, producing videos, and collaborating on web design projects. The role also involves brainstorming creative concepts, ensuring brand consistency, and delivering innovative design solutions that meet project goals.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Multimedia and Video Production
  • Strong skills in Graphic Design and Graphics creation
  • Experience in Web Design and familiarity with responsive design principles
  • Knowledge of design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, etc.)
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work in a remote environment
  • Attention to detail and strong creative problem-solving abilities
  • Working knowledge of digital marketing principles is a plus
  • A portfolio showcasing creative multimedia and design projects

Salary Range

$1,200 - $1,500 USD per month

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.



*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

Job Title: SAP Functional TM

Experience : 5+ Years

Location : Remote - Brazil

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - (Vue / Node.js)
description:
This is a 100% Remote Independent Contractor Role.


About Equate Media

Equate Media is a growth-focused digital company that builds software and operational systems designed to improve efficiency, support customer engagement, and drive measurable business results. Our teams work closely across engineering, marketing, and operations to solve practical problems, improve workflows, and create systems that make a real impact. We value speed, ownership, adaptability, and people who enjoy building useful things in a fast-moving environment.


About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer to help strengthen and expand a real-time communications platform used every day by the business. This person will step into an existing production environment, work through active issues, improve platform reliability, and help push new functionality into production quickly.


The work touches both frontend and backend systems tied to inbound and outbound call activity, routing logic, internal buffering, operational tooling, and live user workflows. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving real production problems, working across the stack, and making meaningful contributions without a lot of hand-holding.


Where you’ll make an impact

  • Get up to speed quickly in an existing multi-service production platform
  • Investigate and resolve issues across frontend, backend, and third-party integrations
  • Deliver new features at a high pace while keeping stability and maintainability in mind
  • Improve systems that support real-time call flows, routing behavior, and internal buffering
  • Build and refine interfaces used for live operations and communication workflows
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and platform functionality tied directly to business performance
  • Help improve visibility, reliability, and overall behavior in a live production environment
  • Contribute to engineering decisions and help raise execution standards across the team


Tools and environment

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router
  • Backend: Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express
  • Real-time / Communications: Socket.IO, WebRTC, browser based calling with Twilio/Sinch/similar system
  • Infrastructure / Services: AWS, Redis, RabbitMQ / AMQP, PM2
  • Monitoring / Error Tracking: Sentry


What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience as a full stack software developer
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js
  • Strong frontend experience with Vue, or strong experience with a modern frontend framework and the ability to work confidently in a Vue codebase
  • Experience working in existing production systems, not only creating from scratch
  • Ability to troubleshoot across the stack and solve real-world issues efficiently
  • Experience shipping features quickly in fast-moving environments
  • Strong instincts around performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Comfortable taking ownership and operating independently
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud-based production environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams


Bonus Points For

  • Telephony, VoIP, call routing, or communications platforms
  • Twilio, Sinch, or similar providers
  • Real-time systems, event-driven architecture, queues, or worker-based services
  • Redis, RabbitMQ, or live operational workflows
  • Improving legacy systems while continuing to ship new functionality
  • Exposure to AI-assisted workflows such as transcription, summarization, or automation


Why this role stands out

This is an opportunity to work on a live platform that supports real operational activity and directly impacts the business. You’ll be solving practical problems, improving systems that people rely on every day, and helping shape what gets built next. If you enjoy working in production systems, fixing meaningful problems, and shipping useful features quickly, we’d love to hear from you.

Pessoa Analista de Segurança Pleno - Baseline Windows

description:
Job Title: React Developer

Duration : 5-month contract (until September 2026)

Location: Remote (US East Coast working hours)


Qualifications:

• 3+ years of professional experience as a Front-End Developer

• Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, HTML, and CSS, with a focus on refactoring and component modifications

• Experience with JavaServer Pages (JSP) for developing server-side components and supporting legacy UI development


Overview: You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing the team on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG accessibility improvements before moving on to the next. You’ll collaborate closely with product, UX, and engineering teams to implement pre written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against VPAT, and document improvements. title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our growing DevOps team in Brazil. You’ll work closely with international engineering teams, helping to design, automate, and operate reliable, secure, and scalable systems in a production-critical environment.


This is a hands-on role with end-to-end ownership , exposure to modern DevOps tooling, and opportunities to mentor junior engineers while contributing to platform stability and continuous improvement.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Design, maintain, and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions
  • Manage and support deployments across:
  • OpenShift / Kubernetes
  • AWS
  • Bare-metal infrastructure (low-latency systems)
  • Automate infrastructure and application configuration using Ansible
  • Support and troubleshoot Unix/Linux systems , with integration into Windows environments
  • Implement monitoring and observability using:
  • Dynatrace (system monitoring and alerting)
  • ELK Stack (centralized logging)
  • Collaborate with engineering teams using GitHub , Jira , and Confluence
  • Participate in release activities, including:
  • Planned deployments
  • Post-release verification
  • Incident investigation and root cause analysis
  • Join a rotational weekend release schedule (approx. 1 weekend in every 5)
  • Mentor and support the development of junior DevOps engineers
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools (GitHub Copilot, Rovo, Devin) to improve delivery and operational efficiency
  • Continuously improve documentation, standards, and DevOps best practices


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Advanced English
  • Strong Unix/Linux administration experience
  • Ansible : solid experience writing and maintaining playbooks and roles
  • Git : confident using collaborative workflows
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions)
  • Experience running workloads on Kubernetes / OpenShift
  • Scripting or coding skills (Bash, Python, or similar )
  • Experience supporting production systems


Nice to Have


  • AWS experience
  • Exposure to bare-metal infrastructure
  • ELK Stack administration
  • Dynatrace configuration and dashboarding
  • Windows Server administration
  • Experience in banking, finance, or FX
  • Exposure to regulated environments
  • Experience working in Kanban teams

title: Desenvolvedor RPA UiPath
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.


Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.


Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedor(a) RPA sobre a plataforma UIPATH para nos apoiar em um projeto estratégico junto com uma equipe de analistas e desenvolvedores.


Essa pessoa desenvolvedora irá atuar tecnicamente o time de automatização onde estará inserida. Irá atuar no ciclo de desenvolvimento de RPA desde a revisão da documentação do analista de negócios, análise crítica da complexidade de desenvolvimento, suporte ao desenho e arquitetura da solução, desenvolvimento da automação até as fases de teste, implementação do robô em produção, hypercare, orquestração e sustentação. Deverá apoiar da difusão de boas e melhores práticas a partir de sua célula de desenvolvimento junto às áreas técnicas e de negócios. Essa pessoa será treinada em nosso framework exclusivo de desenvolvimento e metodologia de Hyperautomation, o SmartBPA® que atua desde o Discovery até a implantação do COE.


Trabalhara no desenvolvimento de automatizações de média e alta complexidade baseadas no software UIPATH para processos transacionais com foco em aumento de produtividade e qualidade.


O que buscamos?

  • Pessoa com vivência e experiência em RPA;
  • Pessoa com abordagem consultiva e colaborativa;
  • Pessoa que goste de trabalhar em um ambiente que favorece a competência, transparência e confiança;


Requisitos da Vaga

  • Vivência e experiência em desenvolvimento RPA com a plataforma UIPATH
  • UiPath Certified RPA Associate (UiRPA) ou UiPath Certified Advanced RPA Developer (UiARD)
  • Outras certificações RPA;
  • Graduação em Tecnologia, Engenharia ou Administração;


Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Desenvolvimento em RPA segundo boas e melhores práticas;
  • Entendimento da estrutura e papel do COE;
  • Integração de scripts, conforme necessário;
  • Parametrização no UIPATH Orchestrator;
  • Ampla experiência no UIPATH Studio;
  • Uso de Assets e Queue;
  • Uso de Licenças;
  • Integração de diferentes tipos de Robô;
  • Conhecimento Pacotes e Libraries;
  • Conhecimentos em UIPATH Studio e UIPATH StudioX
  • Gestão de Filas;
  • Desenvolvimento de documentos Padronizado (PDD e SDD);
  • Uso do frameworks;
  • Aplicação de Modern Activities;
  • Experiência com Banco de Dados, Office e OCR;
  • Vivência na metodologia Ágil, tendo como utilização principal Scrum e Kanban;


Desejado, além dos requisitos para vaga, conhecimento em:

  • · Python
  • · .Net
  • · Power BI
  • · Bizagi
  • · GIT
  • · CoE

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer (CLT – Brazil | 100% Remote)


We are a US-based IT consulting firm with 30+ years of experience delivering solutions to global clients. We are currently looking for a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to work directly with a US customer and distributed teams across the US and Latin America.


This role is fully remote (Brazil) and requires strong English communication skills.


What you will do:


  • Design and implement scalable CI/CD pipelines (Java, frontend, Appian)
  • Build pipeline-as-code using GitHub Actions, YAML, and/or Jenkins
  • Define and enforce GitHub standards (branching strategies, PR templates, code ownership)
  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform
  • Work with Kubernetes/OpenShift environments
  • Integrate security into pipelines (SAST, dependency scanning, secrets management)
  • Enable observability (logging, metrics, tracing – Datadog or similar)
  • Ensure compliance and consistency across environments


What we are looking for:


  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (production environments)
  • Solid experience building CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins)
  • Practical experience with Kubernetes

Come to one of the largest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career! Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make a difference, which is why we live in a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal setting to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

Job Title: SAP MM/WM

Experience : 5+ Years

Location : Hybrid / Sao Paulo- Brazil

Language : Fluent/Advanced English


Key Responsibilities:

Desired Competencies (Technical/Behavioral Competency)


Must Have

• Excellent expertise in SAP MM/WM Functional areas

• Must have experience in SAP Core Processes like Consumable Purchasing, Procurement of Direct Materials, Intercompany Stock Transfer, import procurement, Services procurement, Scheduling Agreements, Blanket Procurement process, Intra Company scenarios, Vendor Returns, Sub-contracting Process, Vendor Consignment Process Inventory Management, Approval Release Setup, Output Management, Pricing Procedures

• Must have experience with customization / localization for Brazil

• Extensive experience in analyzing the technology environment and able to create Solution Prototypes


Good to Have

• Good Customer management skills

• Fiori, SAP ABAP knowledge

• Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills

• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, IT, or related field.

• SAP MM or WM certifications. Recommended SAP Certified Associate


Key responsibilities/Expectations from the Role

• Work on SAP ECC implementation project / enhancement for SAP MM/WM Functional Modules

• Analyze business requirements and design solutions that meet customer needs.

• Ability to troubleshoot the issues, change the configuration, create new configuration

• Collaborate with other SAP functional teams, such as PP, SD, and FI/CO, to ensure end-to-end process integration

• Ability to interact at all levels of clients' organizations. Strong analytical verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.


What can you expect from us?

  • Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
  • Opportunities to work outside Brazil
  • A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:

  • Dental Plan

title: Desenvolvedor PHP sênior
description:
Estamos contratando DESENVOLVEDOR SÊNIOR PHP / LARAVEL


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior PHP com forte experiência em Laravel para atuar na evolução de uma plataforma educacional de grande escala, com mais de 150 mil usuários ativos.


Nosso ecossistema é baseado em uma arquitetura híbrida, combinando aplicações backend em PHP/Laravel com WordPress estruturado via Bedrock e Roots Acorn, além de integrações com BuddyBoss e LearnDash.


Não buscamos um desenvolvedor de sites WordPress. Buscamos alguém com experiência real em backend, que consiga trabalhar com sistemas complexos, integrações e performance em ambiente de produção.


O que você vai fazer:


  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações backend em PHP/Laravel;
  • Trabalhar em uma arquitetura híbrida (Laravel + WordPress via Acorn);
  • Criar e manter integrações entre sistemas (APIs, serviços internos, WordPress);
  • Atuar em problemas reais de performance (queries, cache, Redis, processamento);
  • Refatorar código legado, melhorando estrutura e manutenibilidade;
  • Implementar novas funcionalidades com foco em qualidade e escalabilidade;
  • Realizar debugging e correção de problemas em ambiente de produção;
  • Contribuir na camada de apresentação utilizando Blade.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Experiência sólida com PHP moderno e Laravel em ambiente de produção;
  • Experiência com APIs REST e integração entre sistemas;
  • Domínio de MySQL/MariaDB (modelagem, índices, tuning de queries);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de desenvolvimento (SOLID, organização de código, padrões);
  • Experiência com versionamento utilizando Git;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com sistemas existentes e evoluir código legado;
  • Experiência com debugging e análise de problemas reais.


Diferenciais da vaga:


  • Experiência com WordPress (principalmente integração ou plugins customizados);
  • Familiaridade com Bedrock ou Roots Acorn;
  • Experiência com Tailwind ou stacks modernas de frontend;
  • Experiência com Redis, filas ou processamento assíncrono;
  • Experiência com AWS ou ambientes cloud;
  • Vivência com CI/CD e automação de deploy;
  • Experiência com aplicações de média/alta escala.

description:
Estamos contratando DESENVOLVEDOR SÊNIOR PHP / LARAVEL


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior PHP com forte experiência em Laravel para atuar na evolução de uma plataforma educacional de grande escala, com mais de 150 mil usuários ativos.


Nosso ecossistema é baseado em uma arquitetura híbrida, combinando aplicações backend em PHP/Laravel com WordPress estruturado via Bedrock e Roots Acorn, além de integrações com BuddyBoss e LearnDash.


Não buscamos um desenvolvedor de sites WordPress. Buscamos alguém com experiência real em backend, que consiga trabalhar com sistemas complexos, integrações e performance em ambiente de produção.


O que você vai fazer:


  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações backend em PHP/Laravel;
  • Trabalhar em uma arquitetura híbrida (Laravel + WordPress via Acorn);
  • Criar e manter integrações entre sistemas (APIs, serviços internos, WordPress);
  • Atuar em problemas reais de performance (queries, cache, Redis, processamento);
  • Refatorar código legado, melhorando estrutura e manutenibilidade;
  • Implementar novas funcionalidades com foco em qualidade e escalabilidade;
  • Realizar debugging e correção de problemas em ambiente de produção;
  • Contribuir na camada de apresentação utilizando Blade.


O que você precisa ter:


  • Experiência sólida com PHP moderno e Laravel em ambiente de produção;
  • Experiência com APIs REST e integração entre sistemas;
  • Domínio de MySQL/MariaDB (modelagem, índices, tuning de queries);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de desenvolvimento (SOLID, organização de código, padrões);
  • Experiência com versionamento utilizando Git;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com sistemas existentes e evoluir código legado;
  • Experiência com debugging e análise de problemas reais.


Diferenciais da vaga:


  • Experiência com WordPress (principalmente integração ou plugins customizados);
  • Familiaridade com Bedrock ou Roots Acorn;
  • Experiência com Tailwind ou stacks modernas de frontend;
  • Experiência com Redis, filas ou processamento assíncrono;
  • Experiência com AWS ou ambientes cloud;
  • Vivência com CI/CD e automação de deploy;
  • Experiência com aplicações de média/alta escala.

title: Sustainability Specialist
description:
Junior Sustainability Specialist

Location : Remote (Brazil)

Contract : 6 months - 40 hours/wk

Rate : $4-6/hr USD - BRL $4,330-5,200 / month


Job Description

Insight Global is looking for an entry‑level Sustainability Analyst / Sustainability Specialist to join our client's growing sustainability function. This role will support a small, highly collaborative sustainability team of two and will play a hands‑on role in sustainability reporting, environmental impact analysis, and data‑driven research initiatives.


This is an excellent opportunity for a new graduate with relevant academic or project experience, or an early‑career professional (1–3 years of experience) looking to grow their career in corporate sustainability within a global SaaS organization. The role is fully remote within Brazil and requires strong English communication skills due to close collaboration with international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support sustainability reporting initiatives, including data collection, validation, and preparation of internal and external sustainability disclosures.
  • Perform Excel‑based data analysis related to environmental and sustainability metrics, including working with large datasets to identify trends and insights.
  • Assist with environmental impact reporting, including drafting written content and supporting documentation for sustainability reports and customer‑facing materials.
  • Conduct customer and market research related to sustainability programs, expectations, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with the sustainability team and cross‑functional partners to support ongoing sustainability initiatives and operational priorities.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Environmental Studies, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience supporting sustainability or ESG reporting through academic projects, internships, or professional roles.
  • Strong Excel skills, including data analysis using pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and basic data validation techniques.
  • Experience conducting structured research and synthesizing findings into clear written outputs.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a global, remote environment.


Nice to Have

  • Exposure to carbon accounting, greenhouse gas (GHG) inventories, or climate‑related data analysis.
  • Familiarity with sustainability or ESG frameworks (e.g., GRI, SASB, TCFD, CDP) through coursework or practical experience.
  • Experience working in a SaaS, technology, or professional services environment.
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where priorities may evolve quickly.


We may use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the screening, assessment, or selection of potential applicants for this position.

title: Video Editor
description:
Who we are:


Selfless Ventures is a private equity firm pioneering innovation across Commercial Real Estate Services, CPG, and Robotics. Our portfolio companies provide services and products to major clients such as Tesla, Target, Tonino Lamborghini, Costco, Ulta Beauty, and Keurig Dr Pepper. We focus on fostering groundbreaking initiatives that drive success and growth for our clients and partners.


We do not look for resumes - we only look for responses - fill this out:



We’re hiring 2–3 video editors who are:


  • Proficient in CapCut (desktop version preferred)
  • Able to edit cinematic, engaging short-form clips for platforms like TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Have a portfolio of prior edited clips
  • Own a computer that can handle smooth editing (minimum specs below)
  • Reliable, responsive, and deadline-focused


 Required Skills & Experience:


  • Must have edited short-form content before (examples required)
  • Strong grasp of cinematic storytelling, pacing, and transitions
  • CapCut editing proficiency — not just mobile, but full desktop workflows
  • Knows how to use effects, sound design, text animations, and color grading
  • Attention to detail + ability to follow brand voice and vision


️ Minimum Technical Requirements:


  • High-performance computer (i7 or M1/M2 chip or higher)
  • 16GB RAM minimum
  • Fast internet for file transfers
  • Experience using Google Drive, Dropbox, or Frame.io

title: Innovation & Strategy Engineer
description:
Sensor Tower is seeking an Innovation & Strategy Engineer to join our I&S team as it continues to grow and deliver cutting-edge market intelligence solutions to our most valued clients. Reporting directly to the Director of Innovation and Strategy, this role offers a unique opportunity for someone with hands-on experience in data analytics and consulting. You will collaborate directly with customers and engineers to develop and implement innovative market data solutions, contributing to Sensor Tower's leadership in the industry.


Please note: This is an individual contributor role with no management responsibilities.

Employment: Full-time under a B2B contract.


What the Innovation & Strategy will do:


  • Entrepreneurial Innovation & Data Utilization: Leverage your hands-on experience with data to explore and define innovative solutions, developing new use-cases for data assets that scale to create strategic opportunities
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Employ strong analytical and storytelling skills to transform complex data into compelling narratives that communicate insights and persuade stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, engineering, and customers to develop and implement comprehensive solutions, ensuring strategic alignment and integration
  • Client Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including Fortune 500 companies, ensuring their success through strategic insights and tailored solutions.
  • Sales & Strategic Support: Partner with the Sales Team to support business development efforts, articulating the strategic impact of our solutions and aiding in the proposal process.


Experience and skills that the candidate can bring:


  • Data Proficiency: Proven ability to manage and analyze large datasets independently, developing innovative solutions and actionable insights. Expertise in data analysis and visualization tools (SQL, Python, Excel, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrated track record of identifying, scaling, and creating new data use-cases that drive significant business value. An entrepreneurial approach to developing strategic opportunities.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Ability to transform complex data into compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders.
  • Experience in cross-functional collaboration with sales, engineering, and client teams to implement integrated solutions.
  • Client Relations: Proven experience in building and maintaining strategic relationships with high-profile clients, including Fortune 500 companies, focusing on client success and satisfaction.

Sensor Tower is seeking an Innovation & Strategy Engineer to join our I&S team as it continues to grow and deliver cutting-edge market intelligence solutions to our most valued clients. Reporting directly to the Director of Innovation and Strategy, this role offers a unique opportunity for someone with hands-on experience in data analytics and consulting. You will collaborate directly with customers and engineers to develop and implement innovative market data solutions, contributing to Sensor Tower's leadership in the industry.


Please note: This is an individual contributor role with no management responsibilities.

Employment: Full-time under a B2B contract.


What the Innovation & Strategy will do:


  • Entrepreneurial Innovation & Data Utilization: Leverage your hands-on experience with data to explore and define innovative solutions, developing new use-cases for data assets that scale to create strategic opportunities
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Employ strong analytical and storytelling skills to transform complex data into compelling narratives that communicate insights and persuade stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, engineering, and customers to develop and implement comprehensive solutions, ensuring strategic alignment and integration
  • Client Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including Fortune 500 companies, ensuring their success through strategic insights and tailored solutions.
  • Sales & Strategic Support: Partner with the Sales Team to support business development efforts, articulating the strategic impact of our solutions and aiding in the proposal process.


Experience and skills that the candidate can bring:


  • Data Proficiency: Proven ability to manage and analyze large datasets independently, developing innovative solutions and actionable insights. Expertise in data analysis and visualization tools (SQL, Python, Excel, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrated track record of identifying, scaling, and creating new data use-cases that drive significant business value. An entrepreneurial approach to developing strategic opportunities.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Ability to transform complex data into compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders.
  • Experience in cross-functional collaboration with sales, engineering, and client teams to implement integrated solutions.
  • Client Relations: Proven experience in building and maintaining strategic relationships with high-profile clients, including Fortune 500 companies, focusing on client success and satisfaction.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Java Pleno para atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções backend orientadas a microsserviços, com forte foco em APIs REST, regras de negócio e integrações entre sistemas. Essa pessoa terá participação ativa na evolução da arquitetura, qualidade do código e performance das aplicações, atuando em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e com desafios técnicos constantes.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter serviços backend utilizando Java
  • Criar e manter APIs REST escaláveis, seguras e performáticas
  • Implementar regras de negócio e integrações entre sistemas
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção
  • Desenvolver e manter testes unitários e de integração
  • Apoiar na análise de requisitos técnicos e funcionais
  • Identificar e corrigir falhas, bugs e gargalos de performance
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Frontend, QA e Produto
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (planning, dailies, reviews e retros)
  • Contribuir para melhorias contínuas de arquitetura, padrões e boas práticas


O que esperamos de você:

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java (nível Pleno)
  • Conhecimento sólido em Java e Spring Boot
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em JPA/Hibernate ou frameworks ORM similares
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou Oracle)
  • Familiaridade com Git e versionamento de código
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito)
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Noções de CI/CD e pipelines de build e deploy


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com microservices
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
  • Experiência com bancos NoSQL
  • Vivência com cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes
  • Experiência com práticas de Clean Code e SOLID


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de desenvolvimento web para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: Customer Success
description:
Descrição: A ETER é a primeira aceleradora de movimentos de marca do Brasil. Ajudamos empresários a transformar seus negócios em movimentos — com posicionamento, conteúdo estratégico e arquitetura de receita.

Nossos clientes pagam caro porque recebem um nível de direcionamento que não existe no mercado. E a pessoa de CS é quem garante que esse direcionamento aconteça no dia a dia.


Sobre a oportunidade: Essa vaga não é sobre \"atender cliente\". É sobre ser o guardião da jornada de empresários que estão construindo marcas relevantes. Você vai conduzir o acompanhamento de alunos e mentorados, garantir engajamento, identificar gargalos e — o mais importante — saber olhar para o conteúdo e o posicionamento de cada cliente e dizer com propriedade se estão no caminho certo ou não.

Se você entende de marketing digital, consome conteúdo sobre posicionamento e conteúdo estratégico, e quer atuar ao lado de um time que pensa grande, essa vaga é pra você.


Principais responsabilidades


* Acompanhar alunos e mentorados ao longo de toda a jornada no programa

* Conduzir check-ins recorrentes e garantir que cada cliente esteja executando o plano de ação

* Revisar e dar feedback sobre posicionamento e conteúdo dos clientes (carrosséis, roteiros de vídeo, bios, linhas editoriais)

* Identificar clientes em risco de desengajamento e agir proativamente

* Organizar e manter atualizados os status de cada cliente no Monday/Notion

* Apoiar na preparação e follow-up de reuniões estratégicas

* Reportar padrões, gargalos e oportunidades ao time de liderança


Requisitos obrigatórios


* Conhecimento intermediário a avançado em marketing digital — especialmente conteúdo para Instagram (formatos, linguagem, estrutura de roteiros, linhas editoriais)

* Capacidade de analisar um perfil no Instagram e identificar o que está funcionando e o que precisa mudar

* Experiência com atendimento, CS ou gestão de contas

* Domínio de ferramentas: Notion, Monday, Claude, Manus

* Familiaridade com IA generativa (Claude, Gemini, Manus) no fluxo de trabalho

* Comunicação escrita impecável — você vai representar a ETER em cada mensagem


Requisitos desejáveis


* Experiência no mercado de educação, infoprodutos ou consultoria

* Conhecimento sobre posicionamento de marca e narrativa

* Experiência com programas de mentoria ou aceleração


Diferenciais da oportunidade


* Atuação remota, tempo integral

* Ambiente de crescimento acelerado com autonomia real

* Acesso à metodologia proprietária da ETER

title: Lead Consultant (Computer System Validation)
description:
Resumo da Posição

Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Validação de Sistemas Computadorizados (CSV) com sólida experiência em SAP/ERP e Qualificação de Infraestrutura , para atuar em ambientes regulados por GxP em escala global.

Este profissional será responsável por conduzir e executar atividades de validação em sistemas complexos, incluindo participação em projetos de separação de negócios, aquisições e desinvestimentos , garantindo conformidade com normas regulatórias como FDA e padrões globais de GxP



Requisitos

  • Inglês Avançado (obrigatório)
  • Experiência relevante em Validação de Sistemas Computadorizados (CSV)
  • Experiência nos setores farmacêutico, biotecnológico ou de dispositivos médicos
  • Sólido conhecimento em regulamentações GxP e conformidade com FDA
  • Experiência prática com validação de sistemas SAP ou outros ERPs
  • Experiência em Qualificação de Infraestrutura
  • Conhecimento em abordagens de validação baseada em risco
  • Experiência em aquisições, separações ou desinvestimentos
  • Experiência em liderança ou mentoria de equipes

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Mobile - Sênior (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos modulares/multi-lib ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de design systems ;
  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com processo de releases nas lojas de aplicativos Google Play/Apple Store;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com desenvolvimento e automação de esteiras de delivery .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

title: Dotnet Developer
description:
About the Role

StaffingAbroad is seeking a Principal Backend Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer to join a #1 US-based FinTech & Crypto company . This role is ideal for a highly skilled backend developer who excels in C#/.NET and has a strong focus on writing maintainable, scalable, and secure code . You will play a key role in shaping architecture, ensuring system performance, and embedding best practices while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

This is a 100% remote, full-time role Salary $5.000USD to $8.000 USD


What You Will Do

  • Develop and Maintain Applications : Build, enhance, and maintain secure, scalable backend services using C#/.NET and integrate with APIs like Plaid, Dwolla, and Treasury Prime.
  • Shape System Architecture : Contribute to system design, ensuring performance, scalability, and security across FinTech applications.
  • Write Quality Code : Implement and test maintainable, well-documented code, with a focus on automation and software best practices.
  • Support Production Systems : Monitor and troubleshoot production applications to ensure high availability and quick issue resolution.
  • Collaborate Across Teams : Work closely with front-end, QA, product, and IT teams, while mentoring junior engineers.
  • Focus on Security and Compliance : Embed security best practices and maintain compliance with FinTech regulations.


What You Will Need

  • Strong Technical Expertise :
  • Solid foundation in design patterns, software development best practices, and principles like SOLID and Clean Code.
  • Proficiency in C#/.NET, ASP.NET MVC/WebAPI, and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs).
  • Strong understanding of MSSQL database design and optimization.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Experience with modern front-end and server-side technologies such as Node.js and React.
  • Commitment to Software Quality :
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and ensuring code coverage.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly in Azure DevOps.
  • Proficient in version control systems, especially Git.
  • Experience and Education :
  • 6+ years of back-end software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
  • Collaboration and Communication :
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.
  • Enthusiasm for contributing to a collaborative, dynamic team environment.
  • Cultural Fit :
  • Passion for innovation, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Alignment with a culture that prioritizes excellence in FinTech and Crypto solutions.


Plusses Include

  • Experience with iDesign architecture methodology .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, including their tools and services.

title: Especialista em programas
description:
Objetivo da Posição

Atuar de forma estratégica na gestão de programas , com foco na administração de recursos, mudanças de fornecedores e interface direta com a área de Compras , garantindo o cumprimento de prazos, qualidade, viabilidade financeira e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

Buscamos um profissional autônomo , com forte capacidade de autogestão , visão crítica e interesse genuíno em evoluir para posições de gestão.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de programas e dos recursos alocados;
  • Liderar mudanças de fornecedores em parceria com a área de Compras;
  • Interface com áreas multidisciplinares: Compras, Tecnologia, Vendas e Fornecedores;
  • Planejamento, acompanhamento e controle de cronogramas;
  • Negociação de prazos internos e externos;
  • Análise de viabilidade financeira das propostas;
  • Atuação preventiva na identificação e mitigação de riscos do programa.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia;
  • Inglês Avançado obrigatório
  • Experiência comprovada na área de Engenharia;
  • Conhecimento em FMEA e APQP;
  • Vivência com MS Project;
  • Conhecimento financeiro para:
  • Análise de custos;
  • Avaliação de viabilidade econômica de propostas.


Diferencial

  • Experiência prévia no setor automotivo.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Tech Lead
description:
Se você tem perfil de Tech Lead, venha trabalhar com a gente de forma remota em um(a) do(a)s maiores players do setor de investimentos do país.

É uma atuação que combine forte capacidade técnica com visão estratégica, para atuar em projetos de média e alta complexidade.


Essa posição é ideal para quem gosta de atuar de forma hands-on , ao mesmo tempo em que lidera tecnicamente o time, influencia decisões e garante a evolução de arquiteturas modernas em ambiente cloud.


Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica do time, apoiando decisões de arquitetura e desenvolvimento;
  • Projetar, evoluir e sustentar arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e seguras em ambiente AWS;
  • Desenvolver e manter APIs, microsserviços e integrações utilizando Python;
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, como qualidade de código, testes automatizados e versionamento;
  • Analisar sistemas existentes, identificando melhorias, riscos e oportunidades de evolução;
  • Atuar na organização do trabalho do time, definição de padrões técnicos e mentoria de desenvolvedores;
  • Trabalhar próximo às áreas de negócio, garantindo alinhamento entre requisitos e soluções técnicas.


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com Python (FastAPI ou Flask) no desenvolvimento backend;
  • Vivência com arquitetura em nuvem (AWS), incluindo serviços como S3, IAM, EC2, RDS, Lambda e API Gateway;
  • Experiência com microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Prática com testes automatizados, versionamento (Git) e boas práticas de código;
  • Experiência prévia atuando como Tech Lead ou referência técnica.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native;
  • Vivência em projetos de alta complexidade e/ou alto volume de dados;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de arquitetura como DDD, Clean Architecture ou Design Patterns;
  • Experiência com cultura ágil e colaboração com times multidisciplinares.


Perfil comportamental:

  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com foco em desenvolvimento do time;
  • Capacidade analítica e visão crítica para resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Equilíbrio entre execução técnica e liderança;
  • Senso de responsabilidade e ownership sobre entregas e decisões.


Onde? 100% REMOTO;


Formação: área de tí e afins;


Benefícios e Incentivos: Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistências Médica e Odontológica (SulAmérica), Seguro de Vida (Prudential), Previdência Privada (Onze) e acesso ao WellHub para cuidar da mente e do corpo, além de VR Caju.


Desenvolvimento: Coparticipação na assinatura do Alura, ajuda para cursos de inglês, Ciclo de Avaliação de Desempenho com Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), e programas internos de mentoria e capacitação profissional.


Equilíbrio: Com nosso benefício de Antecipação de Férias, quem tem entre 6 e 12 meses de contrato pode aproveitar o descanso sem perder esse direito ao mudar de emprego.


Diversidade e Inclusão: Todas as nossas oportunidades são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Gerente de Projetos de Design
description:
Sobre a vaga

A Bas-Alto é um estúdio de design full-service que opera no modelo de fractional design team : o fundador atua como design lead embedded dentro de empresas parceiras, integrado aos times e às decisões de produto e marca. A Bas-Alto é a estrutura que sustenta essa atuação: um time de designers entregando produto, web e visual design em paralelo, com o Gerente de Projetos/DesignOps garantindo que tudo opere com consistência enquanto o fundador está focado na frente estratégica. Site para referência:


Estamos contratando um(a) Gerente de Projetos para trabalhar como \"braço direito operacional \" do fundador do estúdio na gestão de projetos de design. O papel central é garantir que o time de designers tenha sempre briefings claros, prioridades bem definidas e entregas organizadas, mantendo múltiplos projetos simultâneos rodando com qualidade e sem perder prazo.


Responsabilidades

  • Representar o fundador em múltiplos projetos ativos, sendo o ponto de contato entre clientes, equipe e partes interessadas
  • Traduzir necessidades e objetivos em projetos organizados, com escopo definido, prioridades claras e briefings executáveis para a equipe de design
  • Gerenciar tarefas, entregas e prazos em plataformas como ClickUp, Asana, Notion ou similares
  • Acompanhar o andamento de entregas de design (produto, web e marketing), garantindo qualidade e consistência
  • Fazer o handoff das entregas finais para os clientes, garantindo clareza, organização e um padrão elevado de apresentação
  • Comunicar com clientes no dia a dia sobre atualizações de projeto, próximos passos e alinhamentos gerais, por escrito em inglês
  • Estruturar fluxos de trabalho, cronogramas e processos internos
  • Antecipar gargalos, resolver impedimentos e manter os projetos em movimento


Necessário

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos, de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups
  • Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais
  • Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX.
  • Inglês fluente em escrita e leitura. Mais de 90% dos projetos e da comunicação do dia a dia são em inglês, incluindo termos técnicos
  • Extrema organização e atenção a detalhe para manejar múltiplas frentes ao mesmo tempo
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto com clientes quanto com a equipe
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Jira ou similares)
  • Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups


Remuneração e modelo

  • Salário: a negociar, a partir de R$ 3.600+, conforme experiência e senioridade
  • Contratação: CLT ou PJ, a negociar
  • Formato de trabalho: 100% remoto
  • Horário flexível. Obs.: É necessária disponibilidade para atender demandas também no período noturno, devido ao fuso horário de clientes da Califórnia (4h antes do Brasil).

title: Consultor de Vendas Externo
description:
A Eternity Energia está em busca de um Representante de Vendas Externo, dinâmico e motivado, apaixonado por gerar resultados e contribuir para o crescimento da empresa na nossa unidade de Belém/PR.


Este profissional terá papel estratégico na expansão de nossas vendas, atuando diretamente com clientes, prospectando novos negócios e fortalecendo nossa presença no mercado de energia sustentável.


Se você gosta de desafios, é organizado e quer fazer a diferença, queremos conhecer você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar clientes ativamente.
  • Realizar atendimento de qualidade, oferecendo soluções de energia sustentável alinhadas às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Realizar o fechamento de vendas e emissão de propostas comerciais.
  • Fazer follow-up constante com clientes e leads.
  • Registrar todas as interações e informações no CRM da empresa.
  • Participar de eventos e ações externas para gerar novas oportunidades de negócios.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em vendas ativas, prospecção ou atendimento comercial (desejável 1 a 2 anos).
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação: falar bem, escrever bem e persuadir.
  • Foco em resultados, organização e disciplina para atingir metas.
  • Proatividade para buscar clientes em canais digitais e presenciais.


O que oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva: salário fixo de R$3.000,00 a R$4.000,00 (dependendo da performance nos primeiros 90 dias) + comissão + bonificações.
  • Plano de carreira com oportunidades de crescimento interno.
  • Treinamento contínuo e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, colaborativo e motivador.
  • Possibilidade de atuar com projetos inovadores no setor de energia sustentável.
  • Participar de um time que transforma resultados em sucesso.


Local da vaga: Belém/Pará.


Se você tem garra, determinação e vontade de crescer, o seu lugar é na Eternity Energia!

title: Senior Software Engineer (Flutter/Node.js)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role Description:

Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. This assignment supports development and delivery of scalable, high-quality mobile systems and features, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with our backend services and bring Headspace’s mission to life.


Deliverables:

  • Design and develop maintainable and flexible services for mission-critical systems that directly support mental healthcare delivery.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather requirements and write RFCs and technical specifications to solve technical and business problems end to end.
  • Effectively communicate technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Use business and technical knowledge to recommend thoughtful tradeoffs between complexity, quality, and delivery speed.
  • Maintain high standards for documentation, code quality, code reviews and operational excellence.
  • Contribute to and influence system architecture decisions, product quality and SLA targets.
  • Apply best practices in testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 2+ years of experience developing with Flutter, including familiarity with Flutter frameworks, third-party libraries, and APIs.
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, with a strong understanding of design patterns.
  • Proficiency with mobile architecture and design patterns (e.g., MVC, MVVM).
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency with Git version control systems and other essential mobile development tools.
  • Experience writing robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge-case handling, using API testing frameworks/tools (e.g., Jest, Gatling, Playwright).
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively partner with product managers, designers, and engineers in a remote-friendly environment.
  • Track record of delivering complex projects across product and technology initiatives.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and keep stakeholders aligned.
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Experience with native mobile development (Android and/or iOS), including the respective SDKs and app release workflows.
  • Experience with AWS and working with databases.
  • Experience with SDUI and CI/CD.
  • Experience with flutter_bloc.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Intelligence Architect | Brazil

Conquer AI is hiring an Intelligence Architect to help us design and deliver real-world AI systems for enterprise clients in Brazil.


This is not a research-only role, and it is not a strategy-only role.

We are looking for a strong software engineer who can work directly with clients, run technical discovery, shape use cases, and then build the solution from POC through MVP and Phase 1 delivery.


Think forward deployed engineer. A hands-on builder who can sit with business stakeholders, understand how work actually happens, and turn that into practical AI systems.


What we’re looking for

  • Strong software engineering background
  • Experience with RAG, LLMs, machine learning, and AI application development
  • Strong hands-on skills in Python and Node.js
  • Ability to design, build, and deploy production-ready systems
  • Confident working directly with clients and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Able to move from problem definition to technical architecture to delivery
  • Strong communication, ownership, and execution skills


What you’ll do

  • Work closely with clients to uncover high-value AI opportunities
  • Lead discovery sessions and translate business problems into technical solutions
  • Build POCs, MVPs, and early production systems
  • Design workflows that combine retrieval, reasoning, automation, and human-in-the-loop review
  • Operate as a trusted technical lead across both client-facing and delivery work
  • Help ensure what gets built is usable, scalable, and grounded in real workflows


This role is a fit for you if

  • You are a builder first
  • You can speak to executives, operators, and engineers without losing the thread
  • You enjoy solving messy workflow problems with elegant technical systems
  • You want to work on high-impact AI delivery, not internal experiments

We’d love to hear from engineers who want to build serious AI systems in the real world.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Laravel, Redux, and TypeScript)
description:
DomainTools is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Internal Team. This position is perfect for someone interested in building powerful cybersecurity products and features for our enterprise customers. Our solutions help fuel mission critical efforts for customers including gathering threat intelligence, doing threat hunting, and performing online fraud investigation, and more.


At DomainTools, you will work as part of a collaborative team of smart and engaged engineers. Expect to spend most of your time developing modern JavaScript single page applications powered by PHR middleware APIs. You will work in an environment where productivity is fostered. You will spend very little time in meetings, and you won’t be distracted by processes that get in the way of high-quality results.


Have you worked with modern PHP OOP frameworks such as Laravel of Symfony? Are you well versed in using CSS and UX to make beautiful and streamlined designs? Have you built successful end to end testing solutions? If you answered yes to any of these questions we would like to chat with you. However, it is required that you are very comfortable with JavaScript.


Job Responsibilities

  • Produce well designed, testable, efficient code using software development best practices.
  • Integrate with and utilize data from backend services and databases.
  • Build web applications using PHP on the backend and JavaScript (ES7+), HTML5, and CSS3 on the frontend.
  • Contribute to new product ideation and implementation as well as to feature development of existing products.
  • Collaborate with teammates by actively participating in code reviews, contributing to technical documentation, and offering constructive design feedback.
  • Become a subject matter expert on DomainTools’ customer facing products and services.


Key Applicant Qualifications

  • Work experience: 3+ years of modern web application development.
  • Experience with modern PHP frameworks (Laravel, Symfony).
  • Solid knowledge of the following:
  • Object oriented PHP 7+ programming
  • JavaScript (ES7+)
  • TypeScript
  • HTML5 and CSS3
  • Deep understanding of React 18+ and Redux.
  • Experience with unit and integration testing (PHPUnit, Jest).
  • Demonstrable experience building and consuming APIs.
  • Proficiency with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Experience with container technologies, particularly Docker.


Pluses

  • Familiarity with configuring Babel, Webpack, and ESLint.
  • Experience with orchestration platforms, particularly Kubernetes.
  • Experience with user acceptance/E2E testing (TestCafe, Playwright).
  • Familiarity interacting with relational databases (MySQL).
  • Experience with UX design and related concepts.
  • Experience using agile principles and methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.


More Details:

  • 100% remote in Brazil
  • Salary: up to $53,000per annum

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Job Title: Lead Generation Specialist

Location : Home-based

Country: Brazil


About the role:

In this role, you will create and execute high-impact demand generation programs across the Brazilian market. You will harness data and intent to engage buying groups across key areas such as Training, System Certification, ISA, and Digital Trust, adapting global strategies for local realities. You'll also partner closely with Sales Directors and the Global Digital Hub to convert interest into opportunities.


If you’re a bilingual/tri-lingual, hands-on strategist who thrives in a matrixed environment, come and build the engine that feeds our pipeline across Latin America.


What you will own:

  • Regional demand strategy: Define the LATAM demand plan tied to MQL, SQL, and opportunity targets by country, sector, and persona.
  • Multi-channel execution: Launch integrated programs across email, LinkedIn/paid social, paid search, webinars/events, and content syndication, localized for Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Sales partnership: Build target account lists and joint GTM plans with Sales Directors; enable teams with localized ABM playbooks and content.
  • Tech + intent: Operationalize ABM/intent platforms (e.g., Bombora, Demandbase/6sense/RollWorks) and convert signals into orchestrated journeys.
  • Attribution discipline: Drive clean segmentation, routing, UTM/tagging, and reporting with digital operations.


How you’ll execute:

  • Localization that performs: Tailor narratives to local regulations, industries, and buyer behavior; ensure cultural nuance in copy and creative.
  • Cross-functional sync: Coordinate with field marketing, content, and ops to deliver on time and on brand via Workfront.


How you’ll measure success:

  • Demand quality: MQLs, SAL/SQL conversion, pipeline contribution, opportunities created.
  • Channel economics: CPL/CAC, influenced revenue, multi-touch attribution.
  • Operational health: Launch timeliness, rework reduction, attribution accuracy (UTM coverage).


What you bring:

  • ABM and demand expertise across segmentation, lead scoring, and personalized content delivery.
  • Martech fluency: Salesforce, Pardot (or Marketo), Workfront; hands-on with ABM/intent tools (Demandbase, 6sense, RollWorks, Bombora, Apollo).
  • Experience in building dashboards, reading patterns, and prioritizing optimizations.
  • Strong collaborator across countries, time zones, and stakeholders; crisp communicator.
  • An organized and detail-oriented approach
  • Confidence in managing multiple campaigns at one time.
  • A growth mindset with proactive problem-solving skills.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
  • Experience in B2B demand gen/digital/ABM with measurable campaign success (professional services, SaaS, or regulated industries preferred).
  • Experience in matrixed/global organizations and familiarity with B2B buyer journeys.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Pardot, Workfront, and ABM platforms.


Language & travel:

  • Languages: Strong command of English and Portuguese both verbal and written.
  • Travel may be required to attend events.


Additional information:

Please submit your resume in English.


BSI - Your Partner in Progress

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organizations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, United Kingdom, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.


Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


If you want to contribute to this inspiring challenge, bring your open and enthusiastic mindset to our dynamic team then please apply now!


Our benefits:

We offer a competitive salary plus; 30-days annual leave, paid sick leave, bank holidays, health insurance, life insurance, public transport allowance, meal allowance, vacation bonus, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, paid marriage leave, paid military service leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization — all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.


If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Filmmakers & AI Directors
description:
Spritz.AI está contratando: Filmmakers & AI Directors


A Spritz.AI é um creative studio e production company que desenvolve filmes, branded content e experiências a partir do uso de inteligência artificial, sempre com foco em narrativa, direção, linguagem e craft. Não usamos tecnologia como atalho criativo. Usamos tecnologia para expandir ideia, acelerar produção e viabilizar projetos com mais ambição estética e mais potência de execução. Trabalhamos em projetos que cruzam publicidade, cultura, design, imagem em movimento e novas tecnologias, em parceria com agências e marcas que buscam mais do que peças prontas: buscam visão, repertório e capacidade real de realização.


Estamos buscando profissionais que já trabalham com audiovisual em AI de forma consistente. Pessoas que saibam dirigir, pensar cena, construir narrativa, integrar ferramentas e conduzir um pipeline com intenção criativa. Não estamos procurando apenas operadores de prompt, e sim gente que entende imagem, ritmo, linguagem e processo.


O que buscamos:

— Experiência real com geração de vídeo via AI, em ferramentas como Kling, Seedance, Runway, Pika, Sora, Wan ou similares

— Fluência em Adobe Premiere Pro

— Repertório de direção, montagem e pensamento narrativo

— Entendimento de upscaling, compositing e integração de takes gerados por AI

— Familiaridade com criação de concepts e materiais de pré-produção

— Capacidade de transformar ideia em linguagem visual, e linguagem visual em filme


Diferenciais:

— Workflows em ComfyUI ou outros pipelines node-based

— Experiência com character consistency e turnaround sheets para AI video

— Domínio de img2vid, vid2vid e controle de câmera via prompt

— Portfólio com trabalhos autorais ou comerciais feitos com AI

— Sensibilidade de direção de arte, storytelling e construção de universo visual

— Interesse por processos híbridos entre criação, tecnologia e produção

description:
Descrição da vaga

Descrição da Empresa ROYAL FACE BELEM


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Biomédico Esteta para se juntar à nossa equipe em Belém, PA. Este cargo envolve a realização de procedimentos estéticos, consultas com pacientes, avaliação das condições da pele e a aplicação de tratamentos. As tarefas diárias incluem realizar procedimentos como aplicação de toxina botulínica, preenchimentos faciais, peelings químicos, fios de pdo e outros procedimentos estéticos. Além disso, o profissional será responsável por garantir a segurança e bem-estar dos pacientes, oferecendo um atendimento de alta qualidade. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.


Qualificações

+1 ano de experiência (botox, bioestimuladores, fios e preenchedores)

✔ Perfil comercial

✔ Trabalho em equipe

✔ Foco em vendas e resultados

title: Automotive Account Manager
description:
What you’ll do


  • Manage and develop assigned customer accounts and ensure achievement of sales, profitability, and performance targets.
  • Prepare and negotiate quotations for RFQs, costing and pricing, ensuring alignment with agreed margin levels.
  • Identify and win new profitable business within the account.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships and support company image.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities.
  • Analyse profitability and implement appropriate actions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with customers to resolve issues efficiently, enhance satisfaction, and drive company targets.
  • Develop sales strategies, plans, and budgets for customer accounts.
  • Track business opportunities, reporting , and account performance.
  • Support team development, define KPIs, and monitor performance.
  • Improve sales and quotation processes and ensure efficient operations.


Your profile


  • Degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
  • Min. 3 years of experience in B2B sales management in automotive environment.
  • Understanding of the wire harness products and market is a strong plus.
  • A confident communicator with strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Customer-focused with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Analytical thinker with the ability to turn insights into actions.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to take initiative and lead cross-functional collaboration.
  • Professionally resilient and adaptable to the market changes and challenges.
  • Proactive, with a growth mindset and results‑driven approach.
  • A team player who thrives in a dynamic, international environment.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).


What we offer


  • A dynamic, international environment where your impact truly matters.
  • Real ownership of accounts and the opportunity to shape customer strategy.
  • Career growth opportunities and the chance to develop leadership skills.
  • Collaboration with global teams and leading industry customers.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits package & company car.
