title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Are you ready to launch your marketing career to the next level?


At Qencode, we’re not just at the cutting edge of video technology, we’re redefining it! We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. From Per-Title Encoding AI to Speech-to-Text and subtitles, we’re shipping innovations that change how the world experiences video.


We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator who’s eager to learn quickly and gain broad, hands-on experience across marketing. In this role, you’ll support senior leadership while executing a wide range of activities — from email and social to website updates, HubSpot campaigns and more. It’s an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to grow their skills fast, wear multiple hats, and learn how marketing works end-to-end in a dynamic startup environment.



Your Goals

  • Build and launch email campaigns in HubSpot (newsletters, product updates, nurture sequences).
  • Manage and schedule social media content across LinkedIn, X, and other channels.
  • Update and maintain website content (landing pages, blog posts, product pages).
  • Support campaign execution for product launches, webinars, events, and content rollouts.
  • Coordinate content and creative assets with internal stakeholders and external partners.


Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of marketing experience (internships and agency roles count).
  • Familiarity with marketing automation tools (ie: HubSpot).
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities.
  • Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment.



Benefits

  • Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team.
  • Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded.
  • Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video.
  • Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path.
  • 100% Remote position working with a global team.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit.


About Us

Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world. We have several unique features, like machine-learning powered Per-Title Encoding which reduces file sizes 60% without quality loss, while supporting popular formats like HLS, MPEG-DASH, MP4 and WebM. With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.

  • Manage and schedule social media content across LinkedIn, X, and other channels.
  • Update and maintain website content (landing pages, blog posts, product pages).
  • Support campaign execution for product launches, webinars, events, and content rollouts.
  • Coordinate content and creative assets with internal stakeholders and external partners.


Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of marketing experience (internships and agency roles count).
  • Familiarity with marketing automation tools (ie: HubSpot).
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities.
  • Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment.



Benefits

  • Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team.
  • Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded.
  • Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video.
  • Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path.
  • 100% Remote position working with a global team.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit.


About Us

Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world. We have several unique features, like machine-learning powered Per-Title Encoding which reduces file sizes 60% without quality loss, while supporting popular formats like HLS, MPEG-DASH, MP4 and WebM. With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.

title: SAP Architect
description:
SAP/Integration Solution Architect

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long Term Contract


Requirements

Education:

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
  • Preferred: Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field


Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in SAP technical architecture and integration development
  • Extensive hands-on experience with SAP integration technologies (PI/PO, CPI, Cloud Platform Integration)
  • Strong experience with SAP modules (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, SAP BTP)
  • Proven track record of designing and implementing complex integration solutions in enterprise environments
  • Experience with APIs, Web Services (REST, SOAP), OData, and middleware platforms
  • Strong understanding of SAP data structures, IDocs, BAPIs, RFCs
  • Experience with SAP landscape architecture and system connectivity
  • Demonstrated experience leading integration projects from design through implementation


Preferred Experience:

  • SAP certification in integration technologies (SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP Cloud Platform Integration, PI/PO certification)
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud and hybrid integration scenarios
  • Knowledge of Dell Boomi, MuleSoft, or other enterprise integration platforms
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and cloud-native integration
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines for integration development
  • Experience with SAP Fiori, UI5, and front-end integration
  • Background in Agile/Scrum methodologiesExperience in consumer goods, manufacturing, or retail industries
  • Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2)


Technical Knowledge & Skills:

  • Expert knowledge of SAP integration technologies (PI/PO, CPI, BTP, Integration Suite)
  • Deep understanding of integration patterns, protocols, and best practices
  • Proficiency in SAP ABAP programming and debugging
  • Strong knowledge of XML, JSON, XSLT, and data transformation techniques
  • Experience with API management and microservices architecture
  • Understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman)
  • Knowledge of database concepts and SQL
  • Security and authentication protocols (OAuth, SAML, SSL)
  • System performance tuning and optimization techniques
  • Version control systems (Git, SVN) and change management processes


Soft Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with ability to address complex technical challenges
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels
  • Leadership and mentoring capabilities to guide development teams and foster technical excellence
  • Strategic thinking with ability to align technical solutions with business objectives and long-term enterprise architecture
  • Stakeholder management and collaboration skills across global teams and multiple time zones
  • Strong documentation and presentation skills for technical and executive audiences
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage priorities effectively
  • Change management and adaptability in dynamic project environments with evolving requirements
  • Customer-focused mindset with commitment to delivering high-quality solutions
  • Proactive and self-motivated with strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Continuous improvement mindset with focus on innovation and staying current with technology trends

title: SAP Tax Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented SAP Procure to Pay and Record to Report Tax Specialist to join our client's team in the technology sector. In this role, you will contribute to analyzing, configuring, testing, deploying, and supporting SAP solutions, ensuring accurate localization for Brazilian and Mexican legal requirements, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze, configure, test, deploy, and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions focused on PTP and RTR, especially as they relate to Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes for Brazil and Mexico.
  • Make recommendations for improving business processes and technology enablement, particularly around local tax compliance and statutory reporting.
  • Ensure accurate localization of SAP solutions to comply with Brazilian and Mexican legal and fiscal requirements.

  • Effectively communicate and collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Business Partners, and Senior Leadership.

title: ANALISTA FUNCIONAL PLENO [SUPORTE SAP MM]
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.


ANALISTA FUNCIONAL PLENO (SUPORTE SAP MM)


ATIVIDADES


  • Monitorar e prestar suporte aos processos de recebimento de mercadorias e movimentações de estoque no SAP.
  • Atuar junto às áreas de Supply Chain, Logística e Fiscal, garantindo a correta execução dos processos operacionais.
  • Participar do design, desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções funcionais eficientes.
  • Realizar alinhamentos e governança dos atendimentos de chamados com áreas clientes e equipe de TI, promovendo melhorias contínuas no suporte.
  • Elaborar estudos de viabilidade técnica e produzir especificações funcionais e técnicas para resolução de causas raízes de erros sistêmicos.
  • Acompanhar o andamento das demandas e realizar follow-ups dos planos de ação, assegurando a execução dos testes pelas áreas de negócio.


REQUISITOS


  • Graduação completa ou em andamento em TI, Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Necessário:
  • Experiência em suporte ao módulo SAP MM (Materials Management).
  • Domínio dos processos de Escrituração Fiscal, Movimentação de Mercadorias e Pedidos de Compras no SAP.
  • Conhecimento das rotinas das áreas Fiscal, Logística e Supply Chain.
  • Diferencial:
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de desenvolvimento de aplicações SAP (ex.: ABAP).
  • Vivência com automações de recebimento de mercadorias.
  • Conhecimento prévio na versão SAP S/4HANA.



CLT - Seg a qui 08-18h (sexta 17h)

Modelo híbrido 2x para quem for da região de Boituva/SP ou 100% remoto para outras regiões.



✅ Benefícios que fazem a diferença:

  • Plano de Saúde

title: SAP SD
description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP SD Functional Consultant to support the Brazil Tax Reform Program , ensuring full readiness and adaptation of Order-to‑Cash processes to the new tax structure (IVA Dual / CBS). This role requires strong functional expertise, deep knowledge of Brazilian localization, and hands‑on experience with tax‑related SAP projects.

Key Requirements

  • Advanced English (mandatory).
  • Experience in SAP SD / Order‑to‑Cash.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise in Brazilian localization , including:
  • NFe
  • CFOP
  • Tax conditions
  • Pricing determination
  • Proven experience with Brazil Tax Reform readiness , including mapping new tax scenarios and adapting SD billing flows.
  • Knowledge of integration points with FI/MM related to tax calculation.
  • Previous participation in SAP upgrade, rollout, or legal change projects .

Responsibilities

  • Analyze existing SD processes and determine required adjustments related to the Tax Reform.
  • Redesign pricing schemas, tax condition records, fiscal flows, and billing structures (IVA Dual / CBS).
  • Prepare functional specifications and collaborate closely with technical (ABAP) teams.
  • Lead integration testing, regression testing, and UAT cycles.
  • Support Cutover , Go‑Live , and Hypercare phases.
  • Produce functional documentation and deliver training to business users.
  • Work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams (tax, finance, logistics).

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
About the role:

The Demand Generation Manager is responsible for ensuring that clients receive high-quality marketing execution that drives measurable results. Whether through points our hours, this role ensures work is delivered efficiently and transparently based on each client’s contract.

This role requires strong strategic thinking, project management, and client relationship skills to ensure marketing initiatives are effectively planned, executed, and optimized. You will act as the primary contact for clients, overseeing campaign execution, aligning resources, and ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.

As an Account Manager , you’ll be responsible for translating client goals into actionable deliverables , managing project priorities, and ensuring each initiative aligns with their business objectives.


Key Responsibilities:Client Strategy & Execution

● Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment on objectives.

● Guide quarterly strategy calls , translating business goals into structured marketing initiatives.

● Define and prioritize client deliverables , ensuring efficient execution.

● Proactively provide strategic insights and recommendations to enhance marketing performance.

Project & Resource Management

● Oversee the execution of marketing campaigns , coordinating with Specialists to achieve desired results.

● Monitor progress on deliverables , ensuring projects stay within the allocated scope.

● Manage deadlines, approvals, and revisions , ensuring seamless project completion.

● Work with internal teams to optimize workflows and improve efficiency in marketing execution.

Performance & Optimization

● Track and analyze marketing performance , identifying areas for optimization.

● Collaborate with channel heads and Account Directors to ensure high quality deliverables get produced and contribute to client goals.

● Regularly review client satisfaction and engagement , proactively addressing potential issues.

● Identify opportunities for upselling additional services that align with client needs.

● Collaborate with the Growth Manager to ensure high client retention and continued success.

Success Metrics

In this role, you’ll be accountable for the following key performance indicators:

● Client point burden , ensuring each client remains on track based on the amount of points/hours purchased.

● Client goals, ensuring we are hitting the pre-defined targets set forth to define specific outcomes from the engagement


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in-house in B2B digital marketing or demand generation, ideally within software and technology.
  • Hands-on experience managing paid media channels and optimizing digital performance.
  • Strong understanding of funnel metrics, digital attribution models, and revenue-oriented KPIs.
  • Excellent project management skills; capable of managing internal projects and multiple external vendors.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a solid grasp of attribution models and proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, DreamData, or similar.
  • Familiarity with technical tools like Google Tag Manager, and Optimizely or VWO.
  • The ability to self-direct and self-start and work independently as well as within and across teams.
  • Hands-on experience in using marketing automation technology (HubSpot) and CRM (HubSpot).
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
  • C1 or C2 English proficiency level.
  • CV and LinkedIn profile in English showcasing experience in chronological order.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Prior experience in a growth-stage or scale-up SaaS business.
  • Familiarity with content personalization, dynamic content, or account-based web experiences.
  • Experience with SQL or business intelligence tools (e.g., Domo, Looker, Tableau, etc.).

title: QA Pleno
description:
Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.


Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar em modelo 100% remoto, integrando o time de Tecnologia. Esta pessoa terá um papel fundamental no desenho e evolução de uma plataforma escalável e governada, utilizando automação e agentes de IA, além de otimizar processos e operações em larga escala.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Acompanhar métricas de performance e a qualidade das entregas, promovendo melhoria contínua.
  • Prezar por um ambiente de trabalho ágil, colaborativo, orientado por métricas e focado na melhoria da jornada do cliente.
  • Apoiar a equipe na adoção de bons processos de desenvolvimento, garantindo alinhamento interno e com stakeholders, e entregas consistentes de software de qualidade.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de teste para garantir produtos com alta qualidade.
  • Identificar problemas e oportunidades, comunicando-os de forma clara às lideranças.
  • Automatizar testes com base em análise de riscos.
  • Apoiar o time de Qualidade com as melhores práticas de testes e automação.
  • Automatizar testes para diferentes sistemas (Front-end e Back-end).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de desenvolvimento em ambiente ágil, participando de todas as fases do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Conhecimento em técnicas de teste: caixa branca e caixa preta.
  • Experiência com uma ou mais das seguintes ferramentas: Ruby, Cypress, Selenium ou Cucumber.
  • Conhecimento em estratégia e gerenciamento de testes.
  • Experiência com métodos ágeis (BDD, Scrum e/ou Kanban).
  • Experiência com testes funcionais (regressão e exploratório).
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de massa de dados para testes.


Seria muito legal se você tivesse:


  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação.
  • Certificação na área de testes.
  • Experiência com testes não funcionais (performance, carga e acessibilidade).
  • Familiaridade com métricas e indicadores de performance.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery).


Informações adicionais:

Local de Trabalho: Brasil | Remoto.


Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:


  • PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica : Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família.
  • Vale Refeição : Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia! ️
  • Seguro de Vida : Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar em modelo 100% remoto, integrando o time de Tecnologia. Esta pessoa terá um papel fundamental no desenho e evolução de uma plataforma escalável e governada, utilizando automação e agentes de IA, além de otimizar processos e operações em larga escala.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Acompanhar métricas de performance e a qualidade das entregas, promovendo melhoria contínua.
  • Prezar por um ambiente de trabalho ágil, colaborativo, orientado por métricas e focado na melhoria da jornada do cliente.
  • Apoiar a equipe na adoção de bons processos de desenvolvimento, garantindo alinhamento interno e com stakeholders, e entregas consistentes de software de qualidade.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de teste para garantir produtos com alta qualidade.
  • Identificar problemas e oportunidades, comunicando-os de forma clara às lideranças.
  • Automatizar testes com base em análise de riscos.
  • Apoiar o time de Qualidade com as melhores práticas de testes e automação.
  • Automatizar testes para diferentes sistemas (Front-end e Back-end).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de desenvolvimento em ambiente ágil, participando de todas as fases do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Conhecimento em técnicas de teste: caixa branca e caixa preta.
  • Experiência com uma ou mais das seguintes ferramentas: Ruby, Cypress, Selenium ou Cucumber.
  • Conhecimento em estratégia e gerenciamento de testes.
  • Experiência com métodos ágeis (BDD, Scrum e/ou Kanban).
  • Experiência com testes funcionais (regressão e exploratório).
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de massa de dados para testes.


Seria muito legal se você tivesse:


  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação.
  • Certificação na área de testes.
  • Experiência com testes não funcionais (performance, carga e acessibilidade).
  • Familiaridade com métricas e indicadores de performance.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery).

Local de Trabalho: Brasil | Remoto.

SOBRE A MDASS


Somos uma agência Google Partner Premier 2024 e 2025 em franco crescimento fundada no fim de 2022 e já atendemos mais de 150 clientes de diversos setores e tamanhos. Prezamos por uma gestão baseada no método CARE, exclusivo da MDASS, para gerir tráfego pago.


Saiba mais aqui:


QUEM ESTAMOS BUSCANDO?


O gestor de tráfego será responsável por planejar e executar estratégias de mídia paga para empresas de diferentes segmentos. Este profissional será um especialista em campanhas pagas, utilizando plataformas de publicidade online, análise de dados e otimização de funis de conversão para maximizar o retorno sobre o investimento (ROI) e alcançar os diferentes objetivos, de acordo com o negócio de cada cliente.


PRÉ-REQUISITOS

  • Disponibilidade de tempo para gerenciar até 10 clientes;
  • Conhecimentos hands-on em gestão de mídia paga, especialmente em Google Search e Meta Ads;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara;
  • Habilidade analítica para retirar insights através dos Dashboards, da ferramenta e internos.


Análise e Otimização:

  • Monitorar o desempenho das campanhas, analisar dados e identificar áreas de melhoria.
  • Implementar práticas de otimização contínua para maximizar a eficácia das campanhas.
  • Tomar decisões diárias para otimização de campanhas.


Atendimento diário com os clientes:

  • Preparação de relatórios regulares sobre o desempenho das campanhas.
  • Apresentação de estratégia, insights e melhorias.
  • Atencimento aos clientes via WhatsApp e/ou e-mail.


Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Experiência de mais de 3 anos com tráfego pago.
  • Certificados Google Ads;
  • Graduação na área de Adm, Marketing ou Comunicação.


Atuação 100% home office;

description:
Consultor Técnico HCM ORC (Oracle Recruiting Cloud)

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Idioma: Inglês fluente obrigatório


Visão Geral da Posição

Estamos em busca de um Consultor Técnico HCM ORC (Oracle Recruiting Cloud) com forte conhecimento técnico em Oracle HCM Cloud para integrar nosso time.

O profissional ideal deve possuir entre 5 e 8 anos de experiência, com perfil predominantemente técnico (80%) e funcional (20%), sendo responsável por desenvolver, manter e suportar soluções técnicas relacionadas ao Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC) e demais módulos do Oracle HCM Cloud.

Além disso, é necessário inglês fluente, pois o profissional atuará em um ambiente internacional, com interação frequente com equipes globais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolver, configurar e manter soluções técnicas dentro do Oracle HCM Cloud, com foco em Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC).

Criar e manter HCM Extracts, responsáveis por integrações de entrada e saída de dados.

Desenvolver e manter relatórios utilizando BI Publisher.

Desenvolver e otimizar consultas utilizando SQL e PL/SQL.

Criar e manter Fast Formulas relacionadas aos módulos do HCM.

Atuar em atividades de conversão e migração de dados utilizando ferramentas Oracle.

Trabalhar em conjunto com times funcionais para entender requisitos de negócio e transformá-los em soluções técnicas.

Garantir boas práticas em integrações, relatórios e gestão de dados dentro do Oracle HCM.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

Experiência com Oracle HCM Cloud, especialmente Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC) – parte técnica.

Experiência com HCM Extracts (interfaces de integração de entrada e saída).

Experiência na criação de relatórios utilizando BI Publisher.

Conhecimento sólido em SQL e PL/SQL.

Experiência com Fast Formulas em módulos do HCM.

Experiência em Conversão de Dados

Experiência com ferramentas Oracle para migração e carga de dados:

HDL (HCM Data Loader)

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de produto e engenharia, contribuindo para a definição de cenários de teste, automação de testes, identificação e prevenção de bugs em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.


Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.


Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: Competitivo
  • Nível: Especialista


Principais responsabilidades

  • Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema.
  • Criar suítes de testes com base nos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais das features.
  • Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades.
  • Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release.
  • Ter um entendimento profundo dos fluxos atuais do sistema para antecipar riscos e propor melhorias de qualidade.
  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações, atuando preventivamente em casos de instabilidade.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Inglês avançado – Será necessário para se comunicar com times internacionais, participar de reuniões técnicas e colaborar em projetos globais.
  • Formação acadêmica na área de computação – Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com os testes automatizados
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial – Atuação no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido ou presencial, conforme combinado.
  • Tech Stack: Python, Java, Golang, AWS (EKS, SQS, SNS), PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Git, Jenkins, Grafana


Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash benefícios: Vale Refeição, Alimentação e Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Incentivo a educação;
  • Gympass;
  • Day Off aniversário;
  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. Essa pessoa atuará de forma colaborativa com os times de produto e engenharia, contribuindo para a definição de cenários de teste, automação de testes, identificação e prevenção de bugs em todas as etapas do desenvolvimento. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.


Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.


Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: Competitivo
  • Nível: Especialista


Principais responsabilidades

  • Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema.
  • Criar suítes de testes com base nos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais das features.
  • Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades.
  • Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release.
  • Ter um entendimento profundo dos fluxos atuais do sistema para antecipar riscos e propor melhorias de qualidade.
  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações, atuando preventivamente em casos de instabilidade.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Inglês avançado – Será necessário para se comunicar com times internacionais, participar de reuniões técnicas e colaborar em projetos globais.
  • Formação acadêmica na área de computação – Graduação completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com os testes automatizados
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial – Atuação no escritório da Klavi em São Paulo, em modelo híbrido ou presencial, conforme combinado.
  • Tech Stack: Python, Java, Golang, AWS (EKS, SQS, SNS), PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Git, Jenkins, Grafana


Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash benefícios: Vale Refeição, Alimentação e Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Incentivo a educação;
  • Gympass;
  • Day Off aniversário;
  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

title: Performance Marketing Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Paid Media Marketing Specialist to drive high-quality leads by creating, managing, and measuring Digital Marketing campaigns across Google, YouTube, social, and other relevant channels.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on, independent strategic thinker who brings deep expertise in running digital marketing programs and developing digital marketing assets (with our designer) within B2B SaaS organizations.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive, this isn’t the role for you. But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own:

  • Develop programs and strategies for customer acquisition, retention, and expansion through multiple channels, including search, PMAX, social, retargeting, content (written and video), and more.
  • Define KPIs and implement measurement, analytics, benchmarking, and reporting methods to gauge success for marketing channels, campaigns, and initiatives.
  • Drive continual improvements in lead conversion rates and revenue close rates.
  • Continue to scale our marketing efforts and take primary responsibility for exceeding our KPIs for each quarter.
  • Work closely with the overall Marketing team to define required assets such as content, images, video, etc.

title: Ecommerce Email/SMS Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.


About Apex Brands:

We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:

We're looking for an experienced, self-sufficient Email & SMS Marketing Specialist who can fully own the strategy, copy, design, and execution of retention campaigns across multiple accounts.


Role Overview:

We're looking for a full-stack lifecycle marketer—someone who can strategize, write, design, and execute high-performing email and SMS campaigns end-to-end. You’ll be the go-to expert responsible for delivering results across Klaviyo, Postscript, and other tools, and will manage the full lifecycle marketing function for several eCommerce brands.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own Campaign Creation and Client Calendar Planning From A–Z : Develop a campaign calendar for brands assigned to you and execute email and SMS campaigns including strategy, segmentation, copywriting, design layout, scheduling, and testing.


  • Build Automations & Flows: Set up and maintain high-converting flows such as Welcome, Abandon Cart, Browse Abandonment, Winback, Post-Purchase, etc.


  • Design Beautiful, On-Brand Emails: Use Figma or another editor of your choice (or custom code if needed) to design emails that look great on mobile and desktop—and convert.


  • Write Strategic, On-Brand Copy: Craft subject lines, preview text, and body copy that aligns with the brand voice and drives action.


  • Run A/B Tests & Optimize: Continuously test and refine subject lines, send times, content blocks, and CTAs to improve performance.


  • Audience Segmentation & List Growth: Manage lists and build smart segments to personalize messaging and improve deliverability.


  • Analytics & Reporting: Monitor and report on key KPIs (open rate, click rate, CVR, unsubscribes, revenue per recipient, etc.) and use insights to inform future strategy.


  • Client Communication: Hop on strategy calls or send Looms explaining performance, roadmap, and ideas to clients.


Who You Are:

  • Fluent verbal and written English copywriting skills


  • An experience retention & lifecycle marketer who can handle everything from strategy, copy, design, build, test, and optimize.


  • 3+ years of experience in email/SMS marketing for eCommerce brands


  • Fluent in Klaviyo and at least one major SMS platform (Postscript, Attentive, etc.)


  • Strong portfolio showing high-performing campaigns (with clear results)


  • Excellent design eye—clean layouts, great typography, conversion-focused styling


  • Strong copywriting skills—can write clear, engaging, persuasive emails for a variety of brand voices


  • Ability to manage multiple clients and timelines without dropping the ball


  • Agency experience preferred


  • Bonus: HTML/CSS familiarity for custom email tweaks


Why Work With Us:

  • Work with top-tier 8 & 9 figure DTC brands


  • Flexible remote work schedule


  • Clear systems and team support, but lots of autonomy


  • Direct impact on performance and client growth


  • Growth potential into leadership or strategy roles


Compensation:

  • $1500 - $6000 USD per month


To be considered for this role please apply and follow/connect with our CEO (Andrew Giessinger):

title: Account Manager
description:
Remote | Full-time | Core hours: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM EST


Macedo Marketing is a performance-driven paid ads agency working with eCommerce and digital product brands in tier-one markets.


We’re hiring an Account Manager who can own client communication end-to-end, keep things calm when results fluctuate, and drive retention through clarity, trust, and solid execution.


About Macedo Marketing

  • We help eCommerce and digital product brands grow through paid advertising and creative strategy.
  • We’re direct, high standards, and process-driven. We care about results, but we also care about how we get them: honest communication, clear ownership, and no drama.
  • You’ll work closely with media buyers and creatives, but you’ll own the client relationship.


The Role

  • As an Account Manager, your job is to keep 15–20 clients aligned, confident, and moving forward. This is not a “smile and reassure” role. It’s a client-trust role.
  • You’ll lead client calls, handle day-to-day communication, translate performance into clear updates, and make sure the internal team is aligned on what matters most for each account.


Mission

Ensure clients feel confident, informed, and supported while achieving strong performance outcomes, leading to long-term retention and account growth.


Success looks like

  • Clients stay longer because they trust you
  • Issues get handled early, not after clients complain
  • Performance dips don’t turn into chaos
  • Clients understand what’s happening and what’s next
  • Upsell opportunities are spotted and surfaced responsibly


What You’ll Do

  • Own client communication and calls for your book of accounts (15–20 clients)
  • Run weekly or bi-weekly calls with clear structure, next steps, and accountability
  • Translate performance updates into clear, honest client communication


When performance dips:

  • Calmly explain the situation to the client with facts and context
  • Push internally for clarity and corrective action with the media buyer/creative team
  • Keep timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups clean and tracked
  • Make sure client questions don’t sit unanswered
  • Spot upsell and expansion opportunities and flag them internally
  • Collect testimonials / positive feedback at the right moments


This Will Be For You If…

  • You have 3+ years in account management / client success (agency experience is a strong plus)
  • You’re native or fully fluent in English and comfortable leading client calls
  • You’re calm under pressure and don’t take client stress personally
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented, and move fast on important tasks
  • You don’t overpromise to “make the client happy” — you align internally first
  • You’re curious about paid ads and want to deepen your understanding of Meta/Google fundamentals
  • You can handle a client load of 15–20 without dropping quality


Do Not Apply If…

  • You tend to procrastinate or take too long to handle time-sensitive issues
  • You leave client questions unanswered or avoid uncomfortable conversations
  • You “smooth things over” by making commitments without internal approval
  • You’re not interested in learning the basics of paid ads and how our delivery process works
  • You need constant supervision to stay organized


Why Join Macedo Marketing

  • Clear expectations and ownership: you’ll know what “good” tells like here
  • Direct access to leadership: fast decisions, no corporate layers
  • High standards, low drama: we care about performance and professionalism
  • 100% remote: work from anywhere, as long as you overlap 8 AM–4 PM EST
  • Growth path: this role can develop into a Senior AM / Client Lead position
  • Compensation is competitive and based on experience. We’ll ask for expectations in the application.


How to Apply

  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • We’ll send a short application form to shortlisted candidates
  • First interview for standout applications
  • We move quickly with the right people.

title: Consultor Security Cloud Azure SR (Projeto no México)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM em nuvem para detecção e resposta a ameaças).
  • Domínio em Kusto Query Language (KQL) para análise de eventos de segurança.
  • Experiência com automação de incidentes (Azure Logic Apps / Playbooks).
  • Vivência com segurança em ambientes Azure.
  • Conhecimento em automação e infraestrutura como código (PowerShell, Python, Terraform ou similares).
  • Horário comercial de segunda à sexta.
  • Idioma Espanhol Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais com o México).


Responsabilidades:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Cloud Security Specialist para atuar de forma estratégica na proteção de ambientes cloud e híbridos, garantindo alta resiliência e resposta eficiente a ameaças cibernéticas. No dia a dia, você será responsável por implementar e evoluir soluções de monitoramento e segurança utilizando o Microsoft Sentinel, criando dashboards, alertas e automações que elevem o nível de maturidade de segurança da organização. Além disso, irá atuar diretamente na correlação de eventos e investigação de incidentes, identificando riscos e conduzindo ações de resposta com agilidade e precisão.

Essa posição também terá papel fundamental na definição e aplicação de políticas de segurança no Azure, assegurando a proteção de workloads, identidades e redes. Esperamos alguém que vá além da operação, contribuindo com melhorias contínuas, automações inteligentes e boas práticas de segurança.

Se você gosta de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos, com alto nível de autonomia e foco em inovação, essa oportunidade é para você

Se você gosta de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos, com alto nível de autonomia e foco em inovação, essa oportunidade é para você

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: SAP FICO Consultant – ICT / Trading Partner / Healthcare
description:
We are looking for a Senior SAP FICO & SD Consultant to support and enhance a highly customized Trading Partner (TP) / Intercompany Trading (ICT) solution, with strong exposure to Healthcare financial processes (HCO/HCP).

This is a great opportunity to work in a complex, bespoke SAP environment, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, BAU teams, and FUSION teams, and playing a key role in compliance, audits, and continuous improvements.

What You’ll Do

Trading Partner / Intercompany (Bespoke Solution)

  • Support and enhance a non‑standard, highly customized Trading Partner solution
  • Understand and manage end‑to‑end bespoke business processes
  • Translate complex intercompany and TP requirements into SAP functional solutions
  • Support audit, compliance, testing, and documentation activities
  • Collaborate with FUSION teams on enhancements and regulatory changes


SAP FICO (Finance & Controlling)

  • Configure and support:
  • FI: GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting
  • CO: Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, CO‑PA
  • Strong hands‑on experience with:
  • Trading Partner accounting
  • Intercompany eliminations & tax
  • Product Costing (SAP ECC) in ICT environments
  • Support month‑end and year‑end closing
  • Work with healthcare-specific financial processes (HCO/HCP)
  • Experience with SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA (IS‑H is a plus)

SAP SD

  • Support SD processes integrated with Trading Partner solutions:
  • Order‑to‑Cash
  • Pricing
  • Billing
  • Output Management
  • Work with interfaces, IDocs, and custom logic
  • Ensure strong FI‑SD integration

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions with BAU teams
  • Create and maintain BRD, FSD, configuration documents, and test scripts
  • Support UAT, regression testing, and solution validation
  • Work closely with ABAP teams on developments and fixes

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience as an SAP FICO Consultant in complex, customized environments
  • Solid exposure to SAP SD, especially in intercompany scenarios
  • Deep knowledge of Trading Partner / Intercompany (ICT) accounting
  • Experience supporting audits and regulated environments
  • Healthcare domain knowledge (HCO/HCP) is highly valued
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in GSK‑bespoke or similar complex ICT environments
  • SAP IS‑H knowledge
  • S/4HANA transformation or migration experience
  • Experience in global / multinational projects

Gestão de Casos (Case Management)

SLA / Entitlements

Omnichannel (Filas, Roteamento, Capacidade, Perfis de Presença)

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.


Where you Fit In:


As a Senior QA Engineer , you are a key technical leader within Quality Engineering. You own quality across complex, mission-critical systems and play an active role in shaping automation standards, testing strategy, and long-term reliability.


You go beyond execution — influencing decisions and ensuring quality is embedded into the engineering lifecycle.


You are a highly technical, systems-oriented QA professional with strong automation expertise.

You understand how systems interact across the stack and think proactively about risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability. You don’t just validate features — you anticipate failure points, analyze trade-offs, and design quality solutions accordingly.

You are confident leading discussions, mentoring others, and raising the bar for engineering excellence.


The impact you will have:


  • Troubleshoot critical issues across environments and support root cause analysis
  • Reduce flakiness and improve test stability and execution reliability
  • Contribute to roadmap discussions and long-term quality vision
  • Identify strategic quality risks and advocate for prioritization
  • Mentor other QA engineers and strengthen onboarding and technical standards
  • Continuously improving the Automation Framework and overall automation coverage
  • Lead testing strategy for complex, cross-team systems.


What we’re looking for:


Technical

  • Strong experience in automation testing
  • Advanced English
  • Understanding of system architecture and cross-team dependencies
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the full stack
  • Experience improving automation reliability and non-functional coverage
  • Strategic thinking around scalability and long-term maintainability.


Execution

  • Proven ability to lead complex, multi-team initiatives
  • Breaks down large challenges into structured execution plans
  • Owns quality from design through production
  • Aligns technical decisions with broader company goals.


Collaboration & Influence

  • Clearly communicates risks, trade-offs, and system impact
  • Act as a mentor to teammates and contributes to team growth
  • Builds consensus and leads by example.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that.

The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback
  • Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing — workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting
  • Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting
  • Work closely with the rest of the marketing team on campaign development
  • Monitor and improve email deliverability on an ongoing basis
  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate, personalize at scale, and move faster
  • Report on what's working and what isn't — with actual numbers


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years in lifecycle, retention, or marketing ops at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep HubSpot expertise — you should be able to build complex workflows without a tutorial
  • Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation tooling
  • AI-native: you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically to how
  • Strong instincts on B2B customer journeys, PQLs, and usage-based growth models
  • You can write a decent email — you don't need to be a copywriter, but you shouldn't need one for every send
  • Comfortable owning work independently without a lot of hand-holding


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience managing or scaling a lifecycle program from early-stage to mature
  • Familiarity with deliverability tools like MX Toolbox, Postmaster Tools, or similar


ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

They're remote, operationally lean, and genuinely open to how AI changes the way marketing works. If you want to build something real without a lot of bureaucracy, this is a good fit.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Home office

Segunda a Sexta das 08 às 17h.


Principais responsabilidades:

Gerenciar e sustentar ambientes de missão crítica em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP ).

Implementar e otimizar esteiras de CI/CD para automação de deploys.

Trabalhar com orquestração de containers utilizando Kubernetes (K8s) e Docker .

Desenvolver automações de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform ou Ansible .

Garantir a observabilidade dos sistemas (monitoramento, logs e alertas).

Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento para disseminar a cultura DevOps.


Requisitos:

Sólida experiência em administração de ambientes Cloud.

Domínio de ferramentas de IaC (Terraform será um diferencial).

Experiência prática com Kubernetes e ecossistema de containers.

Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions).

Vivência com sistemas operacionais Linux e scripting (Bash, Python ou Go).


Informações adicionais

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Entitlement Engineer
description:
Position : Entitlement Engineer

Duration : Long Term Contract

Location : Brazil, Chille, Colombia ,Costa Rica-LATM

Pay Range: $22/hr - $24/hr



Day to Day:

Insight Global is seeking an IAM Engineer with strong SAP GRC Access Control expertise to support identity and access governance across Tenneco / DRiV’s SAP environments. This individual will manage and enhance SAP GRC capabilities across multiple landscapes, ensure access controls meet audit and compliance standards, and partner closely with security, compliance, and business stakeholders.


Specific Responsibilities:

  • SAP GRC Administration:
  • Manage, administer, and control SAP GRC Access Control across multiple landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • GRC Configuration & Support:
  • Configure, maintain, and support SAP GRC modules, including ARA, ARM, and EAM
  • Troubleshoot workflow failures and access provisioning issues
  • Workflow & Rules Management:
  • Design, configure, and maintain BRF+ rules and MSMP workflows for access requests and approvals
  • SAP Role Management:
  • Perform SAP role design, build, maintenance, and remediation across SAP systems
  • Support user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role changes in compliance with internal controls
  • SoD & Risk Management:
  • Conduct Segregation of Duties analysis, remediation, and mitigation
  • Collaborate with business and application owners to resolve access risks
  • Audit & Compliance Support:
  • Provide access reports, logs, and audit evidence from SAP GRC
  • Partner with security, audit, and compliance teams during reviews and remediation efforts
  • Continuous Improvement:
  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and ongoing IAM/GRC process improvements


Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent professional experience
  • 6–7+ years of experience in IAM Engineering roles
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control (implementation and production support required)
  • Experience across multiple GRC landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • In-depth experience with the following SAP GRC modules:
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA)
  • Access Request Management (ARM)
  • Emergency Access Management (EAM / Firefighter)
  • Strong knowledge of BRF+ rules design and MSMP workflow configuration
  • Extensive experience in SAP role design, build, remediation, and maintenance
  • Single and composite roles
  • SAP authorization concepts (SU24, roles, profiles)
  • Experience conducting Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and remediation
  • Proven experience supporting audits and partnering with compliance teams
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience supporting large manufacturing, automotive, or global enterprise environments


Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP Security and/or SAP GRC certifications
  • Experience in large, global enterprise SAP environments
  • Familiarity with additional SAP platforms and modules

title: Sr. Mainframe Developer (COBOL)
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Sr. Mainframe COBOL Developer to join an international project supporting a US client in the life insurance industry. This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to the maintenance, enhancement, and migration of critical mainframe-based insurance administration systems.



Main Challenges:


  • Maintain and enhance legacy mainframe systems written in Assembler and COBOL , working with VSAM file structures
  • Support and develop applications on the Ingenium platform (COBOL/DB2)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across multiple mainframe environments
  • Support ongoing data extraction and migration efforts toward a third-party administrator (TPA)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure system reliability, performance, and continuity
  • Provide knowledge transfer and documentation to preserve institutional knowledge


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience in mainframe development experience with COBOL (critical)
  • Hands-on experience with IBM Mainframe Assembler programming on z/OS
  • Proven background in life insurance or annuities systems (policy administration, claims, or billing)
  • Experience working with VSAM file structures on mainframe environments
  • Hands-on experience with DB2 on IBM mainframe
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in legacy/production environments
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively in English with US-based client teams


Preferred Background:


  • Familiarity with Ingenium or similar insurance administration platforms
  • Experience with data migration or system conversion projects
  • Exposure to CICS Transaction Gateway and Unix environments
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent


This role is especially relevant for professionals who have worked in life insurance mainframe environments, supported legacy system modernization, and are comfortable taking ownership of a broad range of responsibilities in a direct, fast-paced team culture.

integrity.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses


Role of the QA Team:

Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on:

  • Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution.
  • Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. This involves strong analytical skills to assess user experience and interface design.


While specific technical skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code, and creating automated tests are very beneficial, they are not required.


We're looking for candidates with strong English, product usage analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Analista de teste de automação
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Automation Tester , who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will:

  • Lead QA initiatives for one or more projects, including planning, execution, and reporting.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute automated and manual test scripts, leveraging tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium and API testing frameworks.
  • Mentor and guide junior QA team members, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented environment.
  • Analyze testing results, identify issues, and communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.
  • Participate actively in Scrum ceremonies, providing insights on testing progress and quality metrics.
  • Identify scenarios suitable for automation, optimize testing strategies, and improve testing efficiency.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, and Stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues, ensuring quick resolution and continuous improvement.
  • Stay updated on industry best practices, testing tools, and methodologies.
  • Technical Skills & Knowledge:
  • Testing Strategies: Expertise in functional, integration, unit, regression, and exploratory testing.
  • Automation & Scripting: Proficient in Java and Python; experience with Robot Framework, Selenium, Playwright, and API testing.


Mandatory Skills:

  • Frameworks & Tools: Experience in creating custom test frameworks; familiarity with GitHub Copilot for automation.
  • Methodologies: Agile/Scrum experience, ISTQB CTFL certification is a plus.
  • Testing Approaches: Knowledge of BDD, web testing, and performance testing.
  • Version Control & Management: Proficient in JIRA and GitHub.
  • Soft Skills:
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a creative and efficient mindset.
  • Ability to work independently, self-manage, and adapt quickly to changing priorities.
  • Deep understanding of the product’s purpose and how testing contributes to overall quality.
  • Qualifications:
  • 3-5 years of experience in software QA or related fields.
  • Advanced knowledge of testing tools and automation frameworks.
  • ISTQB CTFL certification (preferred).
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and best practices.

title: Business Development Manager (SaaS Subscriptions)
description:
Company Description

A Hiring Group is dedicated to connecting companies with exceptional talent, empowering organizations of all sizes to succeed. Specializing in staffing across industries including software development, marketing, customer service, administration, and executive roles, we focus on building strong teams. We pride ourselves on identifying and placing candidates who align with the unique needs of each business.


Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager with a strong background in SaaS subscription models to drive revenue growth and expand our customer base. This role will focus on acquiring new clients, nurturing long-term relationships, and maximizing recurring revenue through subscription-based solutions. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in SaaS sales cycles, subscription pricing strategies, and customer lifecycle management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to grow SaaS subscription revenue
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead qualification to closing and onboarding
  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategies focused on subscription growth
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders
  • Drive recurring revenue through new sales, renewals, upselling, and cross-selling
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and customer success teams to align on customer acquisition and retention strategies
  • Analyze market trends, competitor offerings, and customer needs to refine sales approaches
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations and articulate value propositions effectively
  • Negotiate subscription agreements, pricing models, and contract terms
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and CRM data


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in business development or sales, with at least 2 years in SaaS or subscription-based products
  • Proven success in selling SaaS solutions and meeting or exceeding revenue targets
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics such as ARR, MRR, churn, CAC, and LTV
  • Experience managing subscription sales cycles and customer lifecycle strategies
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in B2B / B2C SaaS environments (mid-market or enterprise)
  • Familiarity with subscription billing systems and pricing models (tiered, usage-based, freemium)
  • Experience working in fast-paced or high-growth environments
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills

title: Incident Manager
description:
Your role and Responsabilities:


  • Act as the single point of ownership for onboarding-related operational and stakeholder escalations
  • Perform root-cause analysis , identify risks, assess impact, and drive corrective and preventive actions
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth handoffs and service stability
  • Manage escalations end-to-end, ensuring closure within agreed SLAs
  • Prepare and share clear, structured status reports and stakeholder communications
  • Analyze complex data to support data-driven decisions and continuous process improvement


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Experience in project or operational support roles (IT preferred)
  • Advanced English
  • Hands-on experience supporting large-scale, complex environments
  • Strong expertise in risk identification, escalation handling, and mitigation planning
  • Experience with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Jira , or similar platforms
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and proactive problem-solving
  • Proficiency with MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Word for reporting and documentation


Nice to have:


Familiar with SAP ATLAS tool.


Please submit resumé in English.

title: SAP SuccessFactors Consultant
description:
About the Company



K2 Partnering Solutions is a global leader in providing consultative solutions within enterprise applications, artificial intelligence, and cloud technologies. We specialize in delivering skilled human capital and consulting services to empower businesses in implementing and optimizing critical technology solutions. With an expansive network of over 1 million experts, K2 connects top talent with clients to foster success amidst an evolving tech landscape. Our comprehensive services include consulting, recruitment, professional training and certifications via K2 University, and innovative platform solutions for connecting talent and opportunities.




About the Role



SAP SuccessFactors Onboarding Consultant


Responsibilities



  • Map HR processes to SuccessFactors functionality (e.g., hiring, onboarding, payroll triggers).
  • Employee Central (EC): Foundation objects, workflows, business rules, position management.
  • Recruiting Management (RCM): Job requisitions, candidate pipeline, interview scheduling.
  • Payroll (SAP or 3rd party systems).
  • SAP ERP/S4HANA (using Boomi, CPI, or Point-to-Point).
  • Identity providers for SSO and provisioning.
  • Use tools like Integration Center, Middleware (Boomi/CPI), and API tools.
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT (User Acceptance Testing).
  • Assist HR users in validating workflows, reports, and data migration results.
  • Document test cases and expected outcomes.
  • Collaborate with global HR, IT, and functional leads.
  • Provide input for project planning, timelines, and resource needs.
  • Participate in daily/weekly meetings, status reporting, and risk tracking.


Required Skills


3 - 5 years of experience with SAP SuccessFactors

Experience with Onboarding 1.0 & 2.0

Recruiting Marketing is a must

Based in Brazil or Colombia

description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Job Description:

• Design and deploy Endpoint Privilege Management platforms (e.g., BeyondTrust ) across Windows and macOS environments.

• Install and manage EPM agents, management consoles, and event collectors.

• Conduct Proof of Concept, pilot deployments, and enterprise rollout strategies.

• Develop phased deployment plans for corporate and manufacturing endpoints.

• Create least-privilege policies, application control rules, and privilege elevation workflows.

• Configure just-in-time privilege, application whitelisting/blacklisting, and exception handling.

• Continuously optimize policies based on telemetry and user behavior.

• Provide Tier-3 engineering support and incident remediation.

• Align privilege controls with Zero Trust, NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, and regulatory frameworks.

• Document architecture, runbooks, SOPs, and operational procedures.

• Generate audit reports and dashboards for security and compliance teams.
